caption:
Thread count is the number on the package. It's not the number that tells you whether sheets survive a year of actual washing.

Fabric shows what it's made of after a few dozen wash cycles, not on day one out of the bag. Marketing specs describe sheets fresh off the shelf — they don't describe what's left of them once they're folded into a normal weekly routine.

This set skips the thread-count arms race and still shows up on our best-seller tracking without needing one. That's a harder bar to clear than a big number printed on the packaging.
